card.name: Question openers in headings
card.fires_on: Small words right after a question starter such as What, What are, or How, in headings that ask about a topic. Also fires on the gap after a dash before a number or date.

modes.label: Question heading
modes.description: The word after What or How at the start of a question heading.

modes.label: Dash before number
modes.description: A space after a dash before a number range or date.
